description.en:
Returns the handle of the sound on the environment channel (the map ambience opened by CMND_SND_OPEN_DEF_ENV, for example), 0 if none.
Sound handles are integers. Streams opened with the CMND_SND_OPEN_* commands (BGM, event sounds, voices, Special Move sounds, map ambience) get a handle that refers to a stream channel. CMND_SND_OPEN_SYS_SE returns a packed number that names a sound effect instead.

Handle of the ambient sound, 0 if none.
null if the script system is not ready.

examples.case: Closing the ambience and the music (real usage, from ev42034000.nut)
